research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Europe-led kidswear trade fairs; premium and mid-market childrenswear, newborn to teen
title: SS27 Kids' Couture Materials and Details
summary: Premium kidswear materials: fine Italian fabrics, recycled and certified fibres, sustainable lycra, and natural decorations used with care.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Marie Raxevisky's "Beach Couture" uses fine Italian fabrics and recycled materials, with UPF 50+ certification and coordinated adult and child pieces<sup>[1]</sup>.
- Piccoli Principi uses high-quality technical fabrics including sustainable lycra<sup>[1]</sup>.
- Gray Label works with only two material qualities, made in Portugal<sup>[2]</sup>.
- Senger Naturwelt uses GOTS-certified materials for its toys<sup>[1]</sup>.

design_implications:
- Fewer, better materials; check every certification claim.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Mini-me and family capsules extend premium spend.
